phase: Phase 3E.2 — claim adjudication + first verified dose-bearing activation
rationale: Small pilot against a clearly identifiable authoritative TNAU subset. Records originally derived from the local Stack B dataset backend/rag_service/data/all_crop_diseases_v2.json (source_organization: TNAU, reference_url null). In Phase 3E.1 authentic TNAU URLs were captured from the official TNAU Agritech Portal via site navigation and content-verified claim-by-claim; no URL was guessed or constructed. In Phase 3E.2 every remaining claim in rice-blast-treatment.md was adjudicated against the same fetched pages plus the TNAU CPPS crop-protection publication (pdf/8.pdf, downloaded and text-extracted); unsupported claims were removed or replaced with source wording, and the record was activated only after the full gate passed.

provenancePolicy.source: TNAU — taken from source dataset source.organization
provenancePolicy.sourceUrlReason: Captured in Phase 3E.1 from the official TNAU Agritech Portal (HTTP 200 on 2026-10-05). Not guessed: found by navigating official TNAU pages and verified to contain the record's claims.
provenancePolicy.regionReason: Source dataset location is null. Region must never be inferred.
provenancePolicy.verifiedRule: verified may only be true when source AND sourceUrl are both present (existing project policy) AND the official page content supports every stored claim (Phase 3E.1 gate).
provenancePolicy.activationRule: Only records satisfying the verification rules are activated, via the existing mechanism: v1 seed files + KNOWN_CURATED + npm run migrate:kb. The ingestion CLI stays dry-run-only and writes nothing.

verification.method: webfetch of official agritech.tnau.ac.in pages + HTTP status checks + download/text-extraction of the TNAU CPPS publication (pdf/8.pdf) + claim-by-claim text comparison. A sourceOrganization label alone never counts as evidence; every stored claim must appear in fetched page/PDF text.

claimAudit.claim: C. Neem oil @ 5ml/liter as a rice-blast treatment
claimAudit.verdict: NOT found authoritative for rice blast
claimAudit.authoritativeEvidence: cpdisblast.html, rice_1.html, nurserymgmt.html and pdf/8.pdf's Blast sections state no neem oil. TNAU neem-oil recommendations exist only for other purposes/crops (e.g. sheath rot/blight botanicals at 3%; generic pest-control leaflets) — a different disease and a different rate, so they cannot back this claim.

claimAudit.claim: D. Trichoderma viride seed treatment for rice blast
claimAudit.verdict: NOT found authoritative for rice blast
claimAudit.authoritativeEvidence: TNAU blast pages recommend Pseudomonas for blast, not Trichoderma; TNAU's biocontrol and CPPS pages link Trichoderma to root rot / soil-borne disease, not to Pyricularia/Magnaporthe blast.

claimAudit.resolution: promoted into chemicalControl so the stored claim is explicit and traceable

safety.dosageAuthorizationRule: A dose leaves ResponseValidator's blocked path only when the evidence list contains a record with verified=true AND source AND sourceUrl that is ALSO crop-compatible with the question's own crop (Phase 3E.2 `isDosageBacker`): crop-matching query crop => eligible; query crop unknown => a crop-declaring record is NOT eligible; crop-agnostic verified records stay eligible. Cross-crop, missing, and synthetic/quarantined evidence still block. Provenance requirements are unchanged; the evidence list itself is never filtered (grounding intact).
